pages.text: Combine the Faded Halo left by a Hades Servant with the vestments of the Nether's pale envoys, then offer an Apostle's body as a vessel. Perhaps a sliver of that great being's divinity will awaken, descending into the vessel to fight at your side.
Should your Little Apollyon Servant perish, she will leave behind a Faded Sacred Crown. These offerings can restore her to life, without sacrificing another Apostle.
